text: The pipeline begins with the Data Collection phase.
Raw wide dynamic range images are captured across diverse artificial and natural lighting scenes.
The images undergo postprocessing, including conversion to lossless formats and channel duplication.
Following classification and data filtering, the validated wide dynamic range images move into tone mapping.
Next, the Tone Mapping stage adapts the high dynamic range data for standard face detection algorithms.
Only images meeting a dynamic range threshold greater than thirty-two thousand to one are retained.
These images are processed through twenty-five different tone mapping operators.
This yields twenty-five tone-mapped image sets that are forwarded to the face detection stage.
The final stage evaluates Face Detection accuracy across the tone-mapped sets.
Multiple face detectors are applied to evaluate performance across the varying lighting conditions.
Each detector attempts to locate facial features even in challenging backlit and wide dynamic range scenes.
Finally, the detection outputs are compiled for comparative result and performance analysis.
